title: bzf party
description: A person or an organisation the project deals with, `parties/<id>.json`: the owner, the client, tenants, the Energieberater, a trade, with their roles, contact and the consents they gave. A party document never leaves the organisation that holds it; building documents name no person, and a share names the consent it relies on by this document's id and the consent's (versand.json). This schema describes documents of schema version 1.x; a document of another major version is only required to say which.

roles.description: Its roles in the project. The owner is the principal owner of the building's data (the CEN logbook request's Part A).

identifiers.description: Its ids elsewhere: an Energieberater's number on the Energieeffizienz-Expertenliste, a company register entry.

consent.description: A consent the party gave: to whom, for what, covering which documents, when, and when it was withdrawn. A withdrawn consent stays, with its withdrawal, as the record of what was allowed when.

to.description: To whom: another party's id, or a name where it has no party document.

purpose.description: What for: "Angebot Dachsanierung", "Energieausweis für den Verkauf".

documents.description: The documents it covers, by path or path prefix ("buildings/", "roadmaps/0193….json"); all building documents where absent.

until.description: Until when it holds, where limited.

source.description: Where it is recorded: a signed form among the received files.
